urgent_rule: Schedule same-day evaluation for sustained ventricular tachycardia of 30 seconds or longer, ventricular rate at least 150, syncope, or chest pain when the current signal is clinically interpretable.
artifact_rule: Use waveform interpretation and signal-quality fields. Battery percentage alone neither proves nor disproves an arrhythmia.
preservation_rule: Do not delete, overwrite, or unflag any cardiac alert during scheduling review.
